messages:
mari: noticed ~20% increase in GPU attach failures in us-west2 starting ~02:10 UTC. it correlates with ephemeral NVMe iops spike on a subset of hosts.

alon: saw the same, kube events show pods waiting on persistent-local volumes. attaching failed with timeout. :frowning:

mari: logs from provisioner:
```
E0321 02:12:34.123 attach.go:78] attach timeout: device open: i/o timeout
```

jamie: can you paste iostat from a hit host?

pavan: grabbing from gnode-uw2-37:
```
avg-cpu:  1.2 us, 0.3 sy, 0.0 ni, 98.3 id
Device            r/s     w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz  await
nvme0n1         1500.0   120.4  12000  8400    10.7    45.6
```

sree: that's ~1.5k read ops/sec avg which is fine but latency (await) 45ms is high for nvme. looks like a scrub/cleaner overlapped with a batch job spike.

mari: health checks show scrub cron kicked off across many hosts at 02:08 due to backlog. scrub concurrency was increased to 8 in recent rollout.

alon: oh—we bumped scrub concurrency to reduce backlog cost. new default rolled in last night. rolling it back now.

ops-bot: rollback started for scrub-config → concurrency:8 -> 2 (rollout id: rf-20260321-9). ETA ~10m. :gear:

jamie: temporary mitigation: disable janitor on high-attach hosts and requeue pods? risk: leak tempfiles and more backlog.

pavan: suggest targeted throttle: set scrub.sibling-limit=1 for nodes with GPU attach failures. I'm patching daemonset to annotate nodes in the affected ASG.

sree: agree. also recommend promoting the short-term cache bypass so attach path avoids KV sync. small change: set ATTACH_BYPASS_CACHE=true on provisioner pods.

mari: doing both. annotating nodes now, patching provisioner env.

alon: watching metrics — attach failure rate dropping from 7% -> 2% after annotate. GPU launches are resuming. :thumbsup:

mari: follow-ups: revert the global concurrency bump, add node-level scrub backoff when GPU attach pressure detected, and add alerting that ties scrub concurrency to attach fail rate.

jamie: created ticket INFRA-2247 for post-mortem and cost analysis (we need to quantify tradeoff of backlog vs attach SLO). assigning sree + pavan.

pavan: I'll also add a query to Console that surfaces scrub concurrency + attach failures by node group.

mari: thanks everyone. we'll keep the rollback in place until next week after more tuning. closing thread in ~1h unless something regresses. :white_check_mark:
